title: Clinic hours
text: Sunrise Family Clinic is open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Saturday 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays.

title: Address and parking
text: We are located at 120 Cedar Lane, Suite 200. Free parking is available in the lot behind the building. The main entrance is on Cedar Lane.

title: Services
text: We offer general practice, pediatrics, and women's health. We do not provide emergency care; for emergencies call 911 or go to the nearest hospital.

title: Insurance
text: We accept most major insurance plans including BlueCross Basic and CityCare. Bring your insurance card to every visit. For billing questions, call our front desk at (555) 010-2200.

title: Appointments
text: Appointments are 30 minutes. Please arrive 10 minutes early. To cancel or reschedule, contact us at least 24 hours in advance.

title: Contact
text: Front desk phone: (555) 010-2200. Email: hello@sunrisefamilyclinic.example (demo only).
